metadata.title: A Spectrum Featured in Kokorev et al. 2025: The Deepest GLIMPSE of a Dense Gas Cocoon Enshrouding a Little Red Dot
metadata.description: Stacked and slit-loss corrected JWST NIRSpec/G395M spectrum of GLIMPSE 17775 from JWST DDT # 9223 "Let there be Light: Directly Witnessing the Birth of Metal-Free, Pop III Stars in an Ultra-Faint Galaxy at z=6.5" (PIs: S. Fujimoto and R. Naidu). For more detailed please see the arXiv submission by V. Kokorev et al. 2025 - "The Deepest GLIMPSE of a Dense Gas Cocoon Enshrouding a Little Red Dot". https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025arXiv251107515K/abstract

creators.name: Kokorev, Vasily
